title: Pure Majespecter
summary: The pure Majespecter build with generic Rank 4 Xyz, Links, and staples. Every Majespecter is a WIND Spellcaster Pendulum Monster that cannot be targeted or destroyed by the opponent's card effects and searches a card on summon.

summary.title: Starters
points: Majespecter Raccoon - Bunbuku searches any Majespecter monster when Normal or Pendulum Summoned.
Majespecter Crow - Yata searches a Majespecter Spell, Majespecter Fox - Kyubi searches a Majespecter Trap, and Majespecter Toad - Ogama Sets a Majespecter Spell or Trap directly from the Deck.
Majesty's Pegasus Tributes a WIND Spellcaster to Special Summon a Level 4 or lower Majespecter from the Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Bunbuku into Orthrus - Nue
steps: Normal Summon Majespecter Raccoon - Bunbuku to search Majespecter Porcupine - Yamarashi, which Special Summons itself from the hand while you control a Majespecter.

Link Summon Majespecter Orthrus - Nue using Bunbuku and Yamarashi; Nue adds both face-up Majespecters from the Extra Deck back to your hand and places two Majespecter Pendulums from the Deck into the Extra Deck.
Set your Pendulum Scales and Pendulum Summon your Majespecters to trigger Yata, Kyubi, and Ogama for backrow searches.

summary.title: Pendulum Tribute Loop
summary.text: Every Majespecter Spell and Trap Tributes a WIND Spellcaster as cost, sending your Majespecter Pendulum Monsters face-up to the Extra Deck instead of the GY. On your next turn, Pendulum Summon them back to re-trigger their on-summon searches and reload your tribute fodder.

summary.title: Control & Bosses
points: Majespecter Unicorn - Kirin bounces a Pendulum Monster you control and an opponent's monster to the hand as a Quick Effect on either turn.
Majespecter Draco - Ryu detaches a material when a monster is Tributed to summon a WIND Spellcaster from the Deck, and searches a Majespecter card from the Pendulum Zone.
Majespecter Orthrus - Nue locks you into Majespecter and Dracoslayer Extra Deck summons while refilling your hand and Extra Deck.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Majespecter Wind can be activated without Tributes to Special Summon a Majespecter from the hand or GY, or with a Tribute to summon one from the Deck.
Majespecter Tempest is a searchable Counter Trap that Tributes a WIND Spellcaster to negate a Special Summon or monster effect.
Majespecter Cyclone destroys a monster at Quick-Play speed, Majespecter Tornado banishes a monster, and Majespecter Storm shuffles one into the Deck.
Majespecter Supercell prevents your Majespecter activations from being negated while recycling five Majespecter cards from the GY to draw.
